$comment: The components a model may use in an `openchat-ui` block. The single source of truth: the server builds the system prompt from it and the web app validates and renders against it. `make generate-genui` copies it to both; edit this file, never the copies. A component marked retired is left out of the model's instructions but still drawn, so transcripts that used it keep rendering.

components.name: Card
components.description: A raised container for a few closely related things, such as a price with its breakdown, or a small panel: an icon, a title and subtitle and a status Badge in its header, its content, a footer line. Most blocks need no Card; never wrap a whole answer in one. A Grid of Cards with an icon, a title and a subtitle and no children introduces a set of topics, options or features at a glance. With an image, the picture is the card's cover and the title and subtitle sit beneath it; several such Cards in a Carousel scroll sideways. The image follows the Image rule: src must be an image address listed in a web_fetch or web_search result in this conversation (a page lists its images under "Images on this page"); never invent or guess one. With none listed, leave pictures out. Cards side by side in a Grid are peers: give them the same tone (plain), and use accent only to mark the one you recommend; muted is for a quieter card on its own.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Lays its children out vertically.

components.name: Row
components.description: Lays its children out side by side; wraps on narrow screens.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Lays its children out in equal columns; collapses to one column on narrow screens.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A section heading.

components.name: Text
components.description: A paragraph of Markdown: bold, italics, links, inline code and lists are allowed.

components.name: Callout
components.description: A highlighted note: a tip, a warning, a key takeaway.

components.name: Stat
components.description: One key figure with its label, for dashboards and summaries. trend is the direction of the change; tone says whether that change is good or bad news (more bugs is up but bad).

components.name: Table
components.description: Retired: tables are written as Markdown tables. Kept so answers that already used it still draw.

components.name: Chart
components.description: A chart of numbers: line or area for a trend over time, bar to compare amounts, donut or pie for shares of a whole. labels are the x-axis categories (or the slices); each Series is one line or one set of bars with a value per label. A donut or pie uses the first Series only. Use real figures from the conversation or your sources; say in caption when they are illustrative.

components.name: Series
components.description: One series of a Chart: its name and one value per label.

components.name: KeyValues
components.description: A list of label–value pairs, for specifications and details.

components.name: Steps
components.description: An ordered procedure or plan, drawn numbered. Its items are Step components.

components.name: Step
components.description: One step of a Steps list. Give status only for a plan whose progress is being tracked; leave it out for an ordinary procedure.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Events in time order. Its items are Event components.

components.name: Event
components.description: One entry of a Timeline.

components.name: Tags
components.description: A row of short labels.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Alternative views of one subject the reader switches between, such as an overview, performance and security of a product. Its items are Tab components.

components.name: Tab
components.description: One tab of Tabs: a short label and what it shows.

components.name: Details
components.description: Supporting detail folded away behind its title until the reader opens it: a long derivation, the full list, the fine print.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A short coloured status label, such as Done, In progress, Failed or Beta. Several sit in a Row.

components.name: Checklist
components.description: A to-do list with its progress. Its items are Check components.

components.name: Check
components.description: One item of a Checklist.

components.name: Image
components.description: One picture from a source, with an optional caption. link is the page it came from; its site is shown on the picture. src must be an image address listed in a web_fetch or web_search result in this conversation (a page lists its images under "Images on this page"); never invent or guess one. With none listed, leave pictures out.

components.name: Gallery
components.description: Several pictures in a grid, such as views of a place or examples of a style. Its items are Image components.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: A row of Cards the reader scrolls sideways, for options to browse: products, places, articles. Give each Card an image, a title and a subtitle.

components.name: Article
components.description: One news story or article you read: its headline, a two- or three-sentence summary in your words, the page it is from, and its lead image when the page listed one. Several in a Stack make a news digest. src must be an image address listed in a web_fetch or web_search result in this conversation (a page lists its images under "Images on this page"); never invent or guess one. With none listed, leave pictures out.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A horizontal rule between sections.
